
```{r "Packages", include = FALSE, cache = FALSE}

# Load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(scales)
library(here)
library(vroom)
library(Matrix)
library(ggpointdensity)  # To create scatter plots
library(ggseqlogo)       # To create sequence logos
library(valr)            # To create sequence logos
library(bedr)            # To create sequence logos
library(cowplot)         # To arrange plot panels
library(patchwork)       # To arrange plot panels
library(yaml)            # To parse config yamls
library(gprofiler2)      # To perform GO analysis
library(ggrepel)         # To create GO plots
library(colorspace)      # To modify color palette
library(colorblindr)     # github, to modify color palette

# Read functions
source(here::here(plot_params$template_dir, "funs.R"))

# Whether to run the splicing analysis (exon/intron/5'ss)
# * Set `splicing: false` in the genome config for organisms without splicing
#   (e.g. E. coli). Defaults to TRUE when the key is absent so existing
#   eukaryotic configs are unaffected.
do_splicing <- if (is.null(plot_params$splicing)) TRUE else isTRUE(plot_params$splicing)

# Whether to run the pausing-zone analysis (measures pause-zone length over
# several kb downstream of the TSS). Disable via `pausing_zones: false` for
# organisms whose genes are too short (e.g. E. coli). Defaults to TRUE.
do_zone <- if (is.null(plot_params$pausing_zones)) TRUE else isTRUE(plot_params$pausing_zones)

# Human-readable descriptions of the TSS / gene-body pause regions, used in
# report prose. Configurable per-genome (E. coli uses TSS..+100 / +100..end);
# defaults describe the human/mouse TSS..+500 / +500..pAS regions.
tss_desc  <- plot_params$tss_desc  %||% "TSS - +500 bp"
body_desc <- plot_params$body_desc %||% "+500 bp - pAS"

# Metaplot window geometry, per-genome. Defaults reproduce the human/mouse
# values, so configs without a `meta_wins` block are unaffected. Each sub-list
# drives the 5' (tss) and 3' (tes) window merge (win_num/ref_win/win_min/win_max)
# and axis breaks (brk / zoom_brk as c(from, to, by)) and labels, letting
# alternate geometries (e.g. E. coli small windows) work unchanged.
.brk_seq <- function(x, default) {
  if (is.null(x)) x <- default
  if (is.list(x)) x <- unlist(x)
  if (length(x) == 3) seq(x[1], x[2], x[3]) else x
}
.mw <- function(sub, f, d) plot_params$meta_wins[[sub]][[f]] %||% d

meta_geo <- list(
  tss = list(
    win_num  = .mw("tss", "win_num", 800),
    ref_win  = .mw("tss", "ref_win", 201),
    win_min  = .mw("tss", "win_min", 101),
    brk      = .brk_seq(plot_params$meta_wins$tss$brk,      c(-10, 10, 1)),
    lab      = .mw("tss", "lab", "TSS"),
    zoom_lim = .mw("tss", "zoom_lim", 0.5),
    zoom_brk = .brk_seq(plot_params$meta_wins$tss$zoom_brk, c(-0.6, 0.6, 0.2))
  ),
  tes = list(
    win_num = .mw("tes", "win_num", 400),
    ref_win = .mw("tes", "ref_win", 100),
    win_min = .mw("tes", "win_min", 61),
    win_max = .mw("tes", "win_max", 170),
    brk     = .brk_seq(plot_params$meta_wins$tes$brk, c(-3, 3, 1.5)),
    lab     = .mw("tes", "lab", "pAS")
  )
)

# Gene lengths for filtering (kb)
# * Configurable per-genome via `min_gene_len` / `min_zone_gene_len`; defaults
#   preserve the original eukaryotic thresholds.
MIN_GENE_LEN      <- plot_params$min_gene_len      %||% 2
MIN_ZONE_GENE_LEN <- plot_params$min_zone_gene_len %||% 4
```

```{r "Theme", cache = FALSE}

txt_mplyr <- 1.5

ttl_pt <- 10 * txt_mplyr
txt_pt <- 8  * txt_mplyr
ln_pt  <- 0.5

theme_info <- theme_cowplot() +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "plain"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA),
    legend.title     = element_text(size = ttl_pt),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = ttl_pt),
    strip.text       = element_text(size = ttl_pt),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = ttl_pt),
    axis.text        = element_text(size = txt_pt),
    axis.line        = element_blank(),
    panel.border     = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = ln_pt),
    axis.ticks       = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = ln_pt)
  )

theme_colors <- c(
  "#225ea8",  # blue
  "#e31a1c",  # red
  "#238443",  # green
  "#ec7014",  # orange
  "#8c6bb1",  # purple
  "#41b6c4",  # aqua
  "#737373"   # grey
)
```

```{r "Sample names", echo = FALSE}

# Directories
if (!dir.exists(here(plot_params$obj_dir))) {
  dir.create(here(plot_params$obj_dir), recursive = TRUE, mode = "0750")
}

if (!dir.exists(here(plot_params$tab_dir))) {
  dir.create(here(plot_params$tab_dir), recursive = TRUE, mode = "0750")
}

# Set missing sample names
# set default names if not provided
plot_grps$SAMPLES <- plot_grps$SAMPLES %>%
  map(~ {
    .x %>%
      map(~ {
        if (is.null(names(.x))) names(.x) <- str_c("sample-", seq_along(.x))
        
        as.list(.x)
      })
  })

# Set sample colors
sections   <- names(plot_grps$SAMPLES)
sec_colors <- names(plot_grps$COLORS)

missing_colors <- sections[!sections %in% sec_colors]

plot_grps$COLORS[missing_colors] <- plot_grps$SAMPLES[missing_colors] %>%
  map(~ {
    n_clrs <- .x %>%
      map(names) %>%
      unlist(use.names = FALSE) %>%
      n_distinct()
    
    c("black", theme_colors[seq_len(n_clrs - 1)])
  })

# Set replicate names for plots
# set default replicate IDs if not provided
plot_grps$SAMPLES <- plot_grps$SAMPLES %>%
  map(~ {
    ids <- str_c("_r", seq_along(.x))
    
    map2(.x, ids, ~ {
      names(.x) <- str_c(names(.x), .y)
      
      as.list(.x)
    })
  })

# Create data.frame with sample info
sample_df <- plot_grps$SAMPLES %>%
  imap_dfr(~ {
    plt_grp <- .y
    clrs    <- plot_grps$COLORS[[plt_grp]]
    
    imap_dfr(.x, ~ {
      grp <- .y
      
      sam_clrs <- set_names(clrs, names(.x))
      
      imap_dfr(.x, ~ {
        sam <- .y
        
        map_dfr(.x, ~ {
          file <- .x
          
          tibble(
            sampling_grp = grp,
            plot_grp     = plt_grp,
            sample       = sam,
            file         = file,
            clr          = sam_clrs[[sam]]
          )
        })
      })
    })
  })

sample_df <- sample_df %>%
  separate(sample, into = c("sam", "rep"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE)

```

```{r "Gene lists", echo = FALSE}

# Columns for bed files
bed_cols <- c(
  "chrom", "start", 
  "end",   "name", 
  "score", "strand"
)

win_cols <- c(bed_cols, "counts")
win_cols[5] <- "win_id"

# Genome files
# * chrom_sizes / fasta may be given as absolute paths (used as-is) or relative
#   to ref_dir. This lets the genome sequence live outside the gene-list
#   ref_dir (e.g. E. coli refs point ref_dir at the project but the fasta at a
#   shared genome directory).
resolve_ref <- function(p) {
  if (startsWith(p, "/")) p else here(plot_params$ref_dir, p)
}

chrom_sizes <- read_genome(resolve_ref(plot_params$chrom_sizes))

fa <- resolve_ref(plot_params$fasta)

# Gene lists and filter based on length
load_genes <- function(drctry, file, len = 1, rm_cols = TRUE) {
  res <- here(drctry, file) %>%
    read_tsv(col_names = bed_cols) %>%
    mutate(gene_len = (end - start) / 1000) %>%
    dplyr::filter(gene_len > len)
  
  if (rm_cols) {
    res <- res %>%
      dplyr::select(name, gene_len)
  }
  
  res
}

list_dir <- file.path(plot_params$ref_dir, plot_params$list_dir)

genes_5     <- load_genes(list_dir, plot_params$genes_5, MIN_GENE_LEN)
genes_3     <- load_genes(list_dir, plot_params$genes_3, MIN_GENE_LEN)
genes_pause <- load_genes(list_dir, plot_params$genes_pause, MIN_GENE_LEN)

genes_exons <- load_genes(
  drctry  = list_dir,
  file    = plot_params$genes_zone,
  len     = MIN_ZONE_GENE_LEN,
  rm_cols = FALSE
)

genes_zone  <- genes_exons %>%
  dplyr::select(name, gene_len)

genes_exons <- genes_exons %>%
  dplyr::select(1:6)

```
